verdict.rationale: Quo documents a first-party public MCP server and one-click Claude/ChatGPT connectors that let users manage conversations, contacts, and call transcripts "in plain English" with no coding. Documented commands cover summarizing inboxes, sending texts and broadcasts, filtering message and call history, retrieving voicemail transcripts, and adding or updating contacts. Missing for 10: natural-language control of the wider product (call routing, phone menus, number and workspace settings) is not evidenced, operation depends on an external agent host rather than a native in-app command interface, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect Quo to any agent and manage your conversations, contacts, and call transcripts in plain English. No coding required.
One-click connectors for Claude and ChatGPT, plus a public MCP server and an API your own agent can read and act on.
Search your contact list, look up a specific contact’s details, add new contacts, or update existing ones just by asking.
Send a text to one person or broadcast the same message to multiple team members from your Quo number, without opening your workspace.
